findings.text: The confirmation statement is overdue, with a next due date of 13 September 2026 and the last statement made up to 30 August 2025.
Accounts are not overdue; they were last made up to 31 December 2025 and the next accounts are due by 30 September 2027.
Companies House holds no insolvency record for the company.
The company has 10 current officers, including 9 directors, and one person with significant control, CORPORATE CONTROLLER 2676, which holds 75 to 100 percent of shares and voting rights.
The company has 11 satisfied charges registered and no outstanding or part-satisfied charges.
Across 5 of the 9 current directors checked, 49 other companies were found: 36 active, 11 dissolved and 2 in liquidation, and the directors are linked to two companies in insolvency processes.
Since 24 October 2025, no registered office address changes were filed, and one director, PERSON 644, was appointed on 9 July 2026 with no resignations recorded.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 689 is an active company incorporated on 6 December 2013 with no insolvency record, but its confirmation statement is overdue.
